caption: The drawing depicts a single brown, rectangular jug with rounded shoulders and a short neck with a small lip at the top. The jug is rendered in shades of brown with highlights in yellow and lighter brown, suggesting reflections or a glazed surface. The main jug occupies most of the center of the drawing. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a smaller, simplified line sketch of the same jug showing its outline and structure without color. The drawing is set within a light tan or beige background, and is bordered by a faint, thin rectangular outline. The artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," appears in the lower right corner within the border.
title: Pottery Foot Warmer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
